notes: Wigal's Frog API (frogapi.wigal.com.gh/api/v3) authored from the vendor's docs site, the only published description. All 9 documented REST operations are modelled: SMS send (general and personalised share POST /api/v3/sms/send and differ only in where message/smstype sit, shown as two request examples), SMS history, SMS OTP generate/verify, account balance, voice send, interactive voice send, and voice OTP generate/verify. The July stub left out the voice endpoints; they are now included. Delivery reports (DeliveryReport), interactive-voice events and actions (VoiceCallEvent/VoiceCallAction) and Smart USSD v1/v2 sessions (UssdSession) are calls Frog makes to the customer's own URLs, so they appear as components.schemas, not paths. Known doc ambiguities: history is labelled POST with a JSON filter body while its cURL sample uses -G; balance field names differ between the field table (camelCase) and the sample (lowercase), and the sample is followed here. Auth is the API-KEY and USERNAME header pair. The adaptor's only operation, sendSms, POSTs to /api/v3/sms/send, which is modelled. Phone numbers and sender IDs in samples are replaced with placeholders.
